trello.name: Fix staging deploy registry token
trello.desc:
Staging deploy job has been red since morning and cannot pull the base image due to an expired registry token. Ade rotated tokens yesterday and missed the CI token.
Steps:
1. Regenerate the registry token for the container registry used by staging.
2. Update the corresponding CI secret used by the staging deploy job with the new token.
3. Trigger a re-run of the staging deploy job.
4. Verify the job completes successfully.
Acceptance criteria: Deploy job status changes from red to green, base image pulls successfully, and team can test on staging. Estimated completion within 1 hour per Ade.

trello.name: Send updated Meridian proposal to Lena
trello.desc:
Meridian requested an updated proposal with new pricing, promised by end of day today.
Steps:
1. Locate the final pricing numbers in the spreadsheet referenced by Kim.
2. Open the Meridian proposal document and insert/update the pricing section with numbers from the spreadsheet.
3. Retrieve Lena's email address from the Meridian kickoff thread, where she is identified as the procurement contact.
4. Send the updated proposal document to Lena by end of day.
Acceptance criteria: Proposal doc contains the final pricing from the spreadsheet and has been emailed to Lena, Procurement contact for Meridian, before EOD today.
